stories.title: Trial Location Normalization and Distance Mapping
stories.description: Enhance clinical trials service to normalize heterogeneous location data from ClinicalTrials.gov and consistently map each site to computed travel distance and duration fields.

stories.title: Recruiting Status Filtering Enforcement
stories.description: Ensure strict enforcement of recruiting-only trials by validating API query parameters and post-filtering results to exclude non-recruiting or ambiguous statuses.

stories.title: Clinical Trials Result Formatting for Chat Response
stories.description: Format clinical trial results into structured, readable response payloads suitable for LLM consumption and frontend rendering, including key fields (title, phase, location, distance, link).

stories.title: External API Error Handling and Fallbacks
stories.description: Implement robust error handling for ClinicalTrials.gov and routing API failures, including partial results return, timeout handling, and safe fallback messaging.
